summary_1line: Markandeya describes Kalki restoring order after Kali Yuga, inaugurating a renewed Krita age of virtue, prosperity, and restored social-religious order.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kalki, a radiant warrior-sage, rides across the land as thieves scatter while Brahmanas watch and praise him.
At a grand horse sacrifice, Kalki ceremonially gives the whole earth to gathered Brahmanas amid ritual fires and chanting.
Fields and gardens flourish again across the land as people perform sacrifices beside temples and ponds in the newly begun Krita age.
